title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Niral R. Mehta on 19.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 19/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 19.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 19/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-04/2026
It is hereby notified that on 19.10.2026;
1. Hon’ble Mr. Justice Niral R. Mehta would not be available.
2. Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Mr. Justice Devan M. Desai)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Niral R. Mehta.)
By Order of Hon’ble Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
